_comment: Browser support configuration for screenshot widget. Note: Vivaldi masquerades as Chrome and will be auto-detected as Chrome.

unsupportedBrowsers.name: Firefox
unsupportedBrowsers.reason: Firefox requires sharing the entire window instead of individual tabs

unsupportedBrowsers.name: Opera GX
unsupportedBrowsers.reason: Opera may have compatibility issues with screen capture

unsupportedBrowsers.name: Zen Browser
unsupportedBrowsers.reason: Zen Browser compatibility not fully tested

supported.title: Ready to Capture
instructions: Move your MOUSE/CURSOR to the edge of the screen or outside the window
Please don't scroll or use your keyboard during capture
Disable rotation for 3D widgets (use stop rotation button)
Make sure all animations are paused
supported.browserNote: The current tab should be pre-selected. Just click "Share" in the picker.

unsupported.title: ⚠️ Browser Not Officially Supported
unsupported.warningPrefix: This browser is not officially supported for screenshots.
unsupported.recommendation: We recommend using Chrome, Edge, or Helium for the best experience.
instructions: Move your MOUSE/CURSOR to the edge of the screen or outside the window
Please don't scroll or use your keyboard during capture
Disable rotation for 3D widgets (use stop rotation button)
Make sure all animations are paused

firefox.specificNote: In the sharing picker, you must select "Firefox" (entire window) or "Window". Individual tab selection is not available.
